status.passwordReset: Password reset. Sign in with your new password.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Review the account details and workspace access available to this signed-in browser.
account.emailVerificationSent: Verification instructions were sent to your email.
account.emailVerificationUnavailable: Email verification is not available on this server. Contact the server operator.
account.workspaceHint: Choose which workspace opens first after sign-in. Top-bar switching only changes the current browser session.
account.mcpKeysDesc: Active personal access keys for MCP clients.
account.oauthAppsDesc: Apps authorized to connect to dtxWiki.
account.languageOverride: This browser is set to {{language}}, overriding the workspace default.
account.copyUserIdFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the user ID.
account.usernameHint: Identifies your account separately from your display name. It is not used to sign in.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: This one-time link lets you choose a new password. Completing it signs out every browser session.
reset.unavailableSubtitle: This password reset link cannot be used to choose a new password.
reset.invalid: This password reset link is invalid, expired, or already used.
reset.missing: Open your password reset link again. For your security, this page removes the link from the address bar as soon as it opens, so reloading the page cannot reuse it.
reset.expired: This password reset link has expired. Request a new link to continue.
reset.used: This password reset link has already been used. Request a new link if you still cannot sign in.
reset.rateLimited: Too many reset attempts were made. Wait a moment, then try again.
reset.serverError: The server could not reset your password right now. Your link may still be valid; try again.
reset.offline: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
reset.rule: Use 8–128 characters. Spaces are part of your password.
reset.revokeApiTokensHint: Browser sessions are always signed out. Select this if the account may have been compromised; connected tools will need new credentials.
reset.revokeApiTokensForced: This link was issued for suspected account compromise. All API/MCP tokens must be revoked when the password is reset.
reset.revokeApiTokensForcedHint: This protected recovery scope cannot be turned off. Connected tools will need new credentials.

forgotPasswordOperator: Forgot your password? Contact the server operator — workspace admins cannot reset accounts.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your login email. The response is the same whether or not an eligible account exists.
forgot.checking: Checking the recovery options available on this server…
forgot.complete: If the email is registered, password reset instructions were sent.
forgot.operatorOnly: Email recovery is not configured on this server. Contact the server operator.
forgot.unknownEmail: Do not know the email you used? There is no public account search. Contact the server operator; workspace admins cannot recover accounts.
forgot.capabilityFailed: Could not check this server's recovery configuration. Contact the server operator or retry.
forgot.requestFailed: Could not submit the recovery request.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.invalid: This verification link is invalid, expired, or already used.
verifyEmail.rateLimited: Too many verification attempts were made. Wait a moment, then try again.
verifyEmail.serverError: The server could not verify your email right now. Your link may still be valid; try again.
verifyEmail.offline: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
verifyEmail.requestNew: Sign in to request a new link

validation.email: Enter one email address: at most 254 UTF-8 bytes, with a local part of at most 64 bytes.
validation.displayName: Use at most 32 characters without line breaks or control characters.
validation.displayNameHint: At most 32 characters. Leave empty to choose a name automatically.
validation.passwordNew: Use 8–128 characters for the new password.
validation.passwordCurrent: Use 1–128 characters for the current password.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Permanently close your account. Access ends as soon as the request is accepted.
deletion.retention_one: Your data is retained for {{count}} day, then the server worker deletes your account and the workspaces held with it. A period of 0 days makes them eligible for the next cleanup.
deletion.retention_other: Your data is retained for {{count}} days, then the server worker deletes your account and the workspaces held with it. A period of 0 days makes them eligible for the next cleanup.
deletion.sharedContent: Documents, submitted drafts and review history in other workspaces remain; your name is no longer shown as their author after cleanup, and your unsubmitted private edits are deleted. Sessions, API keys and OAuth access are revoked immediately. Until cleanup, a server administrator can restore the account.
deletion.policyFailed: Could not load the deletion details. Reload them before continuing.

errors.user_deletion_last_owner: Some workspaces you are the only admin of still have other members. Delete them, or make another member an admin, then check again.
errors.user_deletion_last_server_admin: Grant server-admin access to another active user before deleting this account.
errors.user_deletion_email_mismatch: The confirmation email does not match this account.
errors.user_deletion_not_found: This account could not be found. Refresh the user list.
errors.invalid_credentials: Your current password was not accepted.
errors.user_deletion_unavailable: Account deletion is unavailable on this server. Contact the server operator.
errors.user_deletion_policy_changed: The retention period changed. Reload the period and review it before confirming again.
errors.user_deletion_targets_changed: The workspaces deleted with your account changed. Check again and review them before confirming.
errors.recent_reauthentication_required: Your confirmation expired. Confirm it’s you again, then retry.

deletion.accepted: Account deletion accepted. Access has ended; retained data will be cleaned up after the retention period. Until then, a server administrator can restore the account.

impact.held: You are the only member of these workspaces. They close now and are deleted with your account:
impact.blocking: You are the only admin of these workspaces, and they still have other members. Delete each one in its Settings, or make another active member an admin, before you leave.
impact.blockingHint: Each button opens the workspace's Settings in a new window. Come back and check again when you are done.

deletion.verify: Confirm it’s you before deleting the account.

errors.sso_transaction_invalid: This sign-in attempt expired or was already used. Start again.
errors.sso_assertion_invalid: The sign-in provider response could not be verified. Start again.
errors.sso_provider_unavailable: This sign-in provider is unavailable. Contact the server administrator.
errors.sso_idp_error: The sign-in provider did not complete the request. Try again.
errors.account_link_required: An existing account uses this email. Sign in using that account’s existing login method, then link this provider under Account settings → Add login method.
errors.email_unverified: Verify your email with the sign-in provider before continuing.
errors.identity_already_linked: This provider identity is already linked to an account.
errors.account_disabled: This account is unavailable. Contact the server administrator.
errors.signup_not_allowed: This provider does not allow account creation. Contact the server administrator.
errors.reauthentication_mismatch: Verify with the provider identity linked to your current account.
errors.unknown: External sign-in could not be completed. Start again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts were made. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.account_email_conflict: This email belongs to an existing account whose address was never verified. No new account was created.
errors.link_email_conflict: This provider account’s email is already registered to another dtxWiki account, so it can’t be linked here. If that account is yours, sign in to it and link the provider there, or ask a server admin.

verification.title: Verify your identity
verification.failed: Your identity could not be verified. Try again.
verification.sessionAccepted: Your recent sign-in allows this action.
verification.emailHint: Confirm your identity using a one-time link sent to {{email}}. Open it in this browser.
verification.restartHint: Use the browser where you started verification. If you signed out, sign in and request a new link.
verification.sent: A verification link was sent. Open it in this browser to continue.
verification.confirmHint: Confirm this one-time email link to continue. Opening the page does not use the link.
verification.ssoConfirmationHint: Confirm that you are signing in as the same account. Your provider may reuse its existing session.

loginMethods.adminVerifyHint: Verify your identity to unlock protected user search.
loginMethods.title: Login methods
loginMethods.description: Manage how you sign in to this account.
loginMethods.passwordAvailable: A password is set for this account.
loginMethods.noPassword: No password is set for this account.
loginMethods.lastMethod: Keep at least one available login method.
loginMethods.verifyHint: Use the verification option below when confirmation is required before linking, unlinking, or setting a password.
loginMethods.verified: Identity verified. You can now manage your login methods.
loginMethods.failed: Login methods could not be updated. Verify your identity and try again.
loginMethods.emailConnectionHint: Optional: register an account email. You can continue using SSO without one. Open the confirmation link in this browser to verify the address.
loginMethods.emailConnectionSent: A confirmation link was sent. Open it in this browser to register your account email.
loginMethods.connectedDescription: Keep the login methods you want to use for this account.
loginMethods.providerUnavailable: This provider is currently unavailable on this server.
loginMethods.addDescription: Connect another sign-in option to this account.
loginMethods.allConnected: All sign-in providers available on this server are already connected.
loginMethods.noneAvailable: No additional sign-in providers are available on this server.
loginMethods.managedByServer: The server administrator manages which providers are available. Connecting or unlinking here only changes your account.
loginMethods.unlinkDescription: You will no longer be able to sign in to this account with {{provider}}. Your other connected login methods will remain available.
loginMethods.providerProfileHint: A provider profile email may differ from your account email.

welcome.login: Choose a sign-in method to open your workspace.
welcome.signup: Create an account to start working together.
welcome.externalContinue: or continue with an external account
welcome.ssoOnly: Use an account provided by your organization or sign-in provider.

emailConflict.title: Finish signing in with this email
emailConflict.mine: If the existing account is yours, sign in with its email and password, then add this provider under Account settings → Add login method. Your documents and workspaces stay in that account.
emailConflict.mineWithoutPassword: Password sign-in is turned off on this server, so the existing account can’t be signed in to here. Ask a server admin to review it.
emailConflict.notMineHint: If you didn’t create that account, ask a server admin to release the address. You can sign up with this provider after they approve.
emailConflict.request: This isn’t my account — ask a server admin
emailConflict.pending: Request sent. After a server admin approves it, sign in with this provider again.
emailConflict.resolved: The conflict no longer applies. Sign in with this provider again.
emailConflict.expired: This request expired. Sign in with this provider again, then send the request.
emailConflict.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again.
